pdfUrls.title: PDF URLs
pdfUrls.description: Public links to digital (text-based) PDFs, one per line: invoices, receipts, purchase orders, W-9s or bank statements. Two free samples are prefilled. Scanned image-only PDFs are skipped and never charged.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Extract: any document, type auto-detected ($0.03). Bank statement: every transaction, pass/fail reconciliation, true revenue, ADB, NSF and MCA positions ($0.25). Preview: page 1 only, free, good for testing.

documentType.title: Document type (extract mode)
documentType.description: Used in Extract mode. Leave on Auto-detect unless you want to force a document type.
